Snikk the Toll-Taker sees you. Reaction roll: 2d6 (3 + 1) − 1 Charisma = 3: unfriendly. "Five gold to pass the arch, or you go back in the river." You may attack, parley (Persuasion DC 13, Deception DC 14, Intimidation DC 15) or pay the toll (5 gp).
